name: Deepwell Rising
storyline:
Solace Industries runs the world. Its crown jewel is the Lift, a space elevator rising from the heart of a megacity, and its most beloved ritual is Lift Day: a monthly lottery broadcast on every street screen. The winners ride the Lift into orbit and transfer to Pegasus, a luxury colony ship promised as a new life among the stars. Weeks later their families receive warm video messages from orbit, and the lottery goes on.

Down in Deepwell, the decaying undercity at the foot of the Lift, the draw is the only hope most people have. The rich live far above them in Zenith, a sealed arcology in the clouds. Between the two lie layers of markets, foundries, temples and slums stacked on top of each other until nobody remembers what is underneath.

Tomas Reyes is a Deepwell courier: stubborn, loyal and not easily fooled. A year ago his mother, Hana, won Lift Day. Her messages from Pegasus still arrive. But in every one of them she calls him "my dear boy". Hana always called him Tomi.
summary:
Deepwell Rising is a top-down co-op twin-stick shooter RPG for 1 to 4 players, set in Deepwell: a decaying cyberpunk megacity stacked in layers around the base of the Lift, the colossal space elevator owned by Solace Industries.

Play solo or team up online with up to three friends. Pick a class, each with its own weapons, skills and playstyle, and fight your way through neon markets, flooded undercity tunnels, steel foundries, corporate districts and abandoned labs against human gangs, corporate security, heavy mechs and alien swarms. Loot drops in five rarities, with weapon talents and armour sets with 2/3/4-piece bonuses to perfect your build.
